commands.name: build
commands.description: Builds all projects in the repository, respecting dependency order

commands.name: rebuild
commands.description: Performs a full clean rebuild of all projects

commands.name: build:worker
commands.description: Builds the core worker bundle that is consumed by the electron app

commands.name: test
commands.description: Runs tests for all projects that have a test script

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Removes build artifacts from all projects

commands.name: start:api
commands.description: Starts the Express API server in development mode

commands.name: start:ui
commands.description: Starts the webpack dev server for the React UI

commands.name: start:cli
commands.description: Runs the CLI with ts-node for development

commands.name: package:electron
commands.description: Builds and packages the Electron app for distribution
commands.shellCommand: rush build && rush build:worker && cd packages/client-electron && pnpm run build

commands.name: build:go
commands.description: Builds the envkey-source binary and envkeygo SDK
commands.shellCommand: cd sdks/envkey-source && go build -o envkey-source . && echo 'envkey-source built' && cd ../../sdks/envkeygo && go build ./... && echo 'envkeygo built'

commands.name: test:go
commands.description: Runs tests for all Go projects (envkey-source and envkeygo)
commands.shellCommand: cd sdks/envkey-source && go clean -testcache && go test -v ./... && cd ../../sdks/envkeygo && go clean -testcache && go test -v ./...
